WITH nl AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date d, s.store_id, f.net_amount v, 'sale' k FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net, 'ret' FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28')
SELECT 'nontrading' chk, nl.store_id, COUNT(*) n, SUM(v) v FROM nl JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date=nl.d WHERE NOT dd.is_trading_day GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'closure', nl.store_id, COUNT(*), SUM(v) FROM nl JOIN ref_store_closure c ON c.store_id=nl.store_id AND nl.d BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'nosales_store', cs.store_id, 0, 0 FROM dim_store cs WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id<900 AND cs.store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM nl)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store_dates:'||cs.store_name||' '||coalesce(cast(cs.open_date as varchar),'-')||' '||coalesce(cast(cs.close_date as varchar),'-'), cs.store_id, 0,0 FROM dim_store cs WHERE cs.is_current AND (cs.open_date IS NOT NULL OR cs.close_date IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank
